paragraphs: He was a student of R' Eliezer ([Eruvin 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.63a.16-18)), for he issued a halakhic ruling in the presence of his teacher, and R' Eliezer said to his wife that he would not live out his year, and so it was.[^1]

notes.text: The Gemara gives the prediction to Rabbi Eliezer in his conversation with his wife Imma Shalom. Rabbah bar bar Chana later gives the student’s name in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1632&lang=en) also records the prediction.
